info.name: Docmon read-only smoke
info.description: Docmon single-machine monitoring and full Docker control. Set baseUrl and bearerToken in a local environment. No real credentials are committed. The complete collection includes destructive requests; select individual requests or use the read-only smoke collection. Generated from live Watson OpenAPI metadata by scripts/export-api.py.

request.description:
List all containers.

- `maxResults` (query, integer, optional): EnumerationQuery MaxResults
- `continuationToken` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery ContinuationToken
- `search` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery Search
- `sortBy` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery SortBy
- `ordering` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery Ordering
- `containerIdFilter` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery ContainerIdFilter
- `startUtc` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery StartUtc
- `endUtc` (query, string, optional): EnumerationQuery EndUtc
- `filters` (query, string, optional): JSON object mapping scalar field names to substring filters.

exec: pm.test("No reported operation failure", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.exitCode !== undefined) pm.expect(b.exitCode).to.equal(0); });

pm.test("EnumerationResult paging contract", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.equal(true); pm.expect(b.objects).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(b.maxResults).to.be.within(1,1000); pm.expect(b.objects.length).to.be.at.most(b.maxResults); pm.expect(b.totalRecords).to.be.at.least(b.objects.length); pm.expect(b.recordsRemaining).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(b.endOfResults).to.equal(b.recordsRemaining === 0); if (!b.endOfResults) pm.expect(b.continuationToken).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

request.description:
Request history time buckets across the retained journal.

- `timeframe` (query, string, optional): Rolling window: hour (60 one-minute buckets), day (96 fifteen-minute buckets), week (84 two-hour buckets), month (90 eight-hour buckets over 30 days).

exec: pm.test("No reported operation failure", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.exitCode !== undefined) pm.expect(b.exitCode).to.equal(0); });

pm.test("History bucket contract", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); const counts={hour:60,day:96,week:84,month:90}; pm.expect(b.buckets.length).to.equal(counts[b.timeframe]); pm.expect(b.totalCount).to.equal(b.totalSuccess+b.totalFailure); pm.expect(b.buckets.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.ok+x.failed,0)).to.equal(b.totalCount); });
